purpose: Status bar for a vertical Apodex-style closed-loop research agent focused on US equity momentum factor risk (not a general Heavy-Duty Solver).

target.shape: Apodex 1.1 managed loop: gaps → Task Pipeline → executable environment + coordination → traces → eval → next round
target.domain: US equity momentum factor risk (Daniel-Moskowitz crash, crowding, unwind). Overlay profiles are inputs to that question, not separate products.
target.not_in_scope: General-purpose Heavy-Duty Solver, SFT/RL on DeepSeek weights, AgentBus, unbounded follow-up

left: real DM engine + delivery verifier V_D
live replan / staged return / branch stop
eval that feeds the next loop

reference.paper: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
reference.definition: Self-evolution is the managed loop: observed gaps → Task Pipeline → Environment Scaling + Agentic Coordination Scaling → SFT/agentic RL → evaluation/failure attribution. It is not the model rewriting its own weights.

overall.summary: Phase 1 orchestration harness (decompose/dispatch/synthesize + disk task board). None of the self-improvement loop stages exist as code.

dimensions.name: Capability-gap mining
dimensions.apodex: Classify real-task failures, benchmark errors, and user/expert feedback into capability deficiencies.
present: Coordinator marks failed sub-agents BLOCKED and mentions the gap in synthesis (coordinator.py dispatch_all/synthesize).
Task.error stores a free-text exception string (schemas.Task, task_board.fail).
missing: No taxonomy (tool misuse, evidence gap, coordination failure, verifier miss, etc.).
Session reports are not ingested as a gap corpus.
No user/expert feedback channel into the board.

dimensions.name: Task Pipeline
dimensions.apodex: Convert classified gaps into the next task distribution with family-specific verification before training signal.
present: One-shot decompose prompt produces 2–5 independent tasks from the user question (prompts/decompose.md).
missing: No held-out task library, occupation/deliverable registry, or difficulty calibration.

dimensions.name: Environment Scaling
dimensions.apodex: File / search / code worlds with state, tools, transitions, budgets, delivery contract D, and verifier V_D.
present: Thin tools: web_search, file_reader (read-only), market_data, 30s shell, mock engine_query.
file_reader refuses paths outside the project.
missing: engine_query is hash-seeded mock data (tools/engine_query.py TODO).
No workspace contract, provenance, replay manifest, or delivery verifier.
shell is unsandboxed; no file-write / artifact publisher.

dimensions.name: Agentic Coordination Scaling
dimensions.apodex: Trained policy for decompose, delegate, staged return, shared-state revision, replan, and stop obsolete branches. Runtime: live task board, async human intervention, asymmetric verification, adaptive team effort.
present: Disk-backed TaskBoard with status machine and save-on-mutation (task_board.py).
Sub-agent failure does not abort the coordinator (asyncio.gather return_exceptions=True).
missing: Decomposition is one-shot; no mid-run board edits, staged returns, or branch termination.
Sub-agents are independent by design (decompose.md: self-contained, no other-task results).
Roles are a fixed five-profile catalogue, not problem-induced.
No async human intervention, Statement Review, or adaptive Max Team Effort.

dimensions.name: Asymmetric / independent verification
dimensions.apodex: Narrow verifier attacks a claim + evidence + delivery constraint; does not re-solve the whole problem.
present: Synthesize prompt asks to flag dissenting views (prompts/synthesize.md).
JSON schema retry once on ValidationError (_complete_json).
missing: No independent reviewer agent, claim-level attack, or source triangulation.
Synthesizer sees generator outputs in the same context (anchoring).

dimensions.name: Trajectory learning (SFT / agentic RL or system analogue)
dimensions.apodex: Unified SFT then agentic RL (PIVOT-RL) over executable and coordination trajectories. Self-evolution reallocates training effort; it does not let the model edit itself.
present: Frozen DeepSeek API client (config.make_client). Models are not trained here.
missing: No trajectory logger (actions, observations, file deltas, termination reason).
No system-level analogue: prompt/profile/tool evolution from session traces.
AGENTS.md forbids extra agent frameworks; a file-based gap ledger + prompt patches would be the in-repo analogue.

dimensions.name: Evaluation and failure attribution
dimensions.apodex: ReAct vs Agent Team eval; capability analysis feeds the next Task Pipeline.
present: Unit tests for task board, ReAct loop, coordinator file-writing (no live API).
missing: No working-capability benchmark, delivery rubric, or replayable eval worlds.
Test failures do not become capability gaps.

nearest_moves: Persist a failure taxonomy from task_board.json + sub-reports after each session.
Make the task board live: staged sub-agent returns, coordinator mid-run add/stop/replan.
Independent statement review of synthesis claims against cited sources.
Replace engine_query mock with the real momentum engine so a verifier can exist.
Log tool traces in a replayable session record (the raw material for any later learning).
